title: Aethelgard Scene Check
checks: Character behavior matches established personality and history
No continuity break in injuries, equipment, location, time, or companions
Dialogue sounds like the individual speaker
Background characters and environment continue naturally
DnD-fitting races, classes, creatures, magic, and terminology are used where appropriate

High Elven language is varied, contextual, and not overused
Language vocabulary does not collapse into repeated invented roots
Lyra's fluency reflects textual study and limited spoken practice
Skull-Veil elves retain menace, distrust, and cultural hostility where the scene requires it

Repeated words such as ledger are controlled
Prose remains human, varied, and readable
Final pass checks for accidental AI-like repetition
